solution: Let the AP have first term \(a\) and common difference \(d\). Its 5th, 7th and 13th terms are \(a+4d,\ a+6d,\ a+12d\). Being in GP, \((a+6d)^2=(a+4d)(a+12d)\). Expanding: \(a^2+12ad+36d^2=a^2+16ad+48d^2\), so \(4ad+12d^2=0\Rightarrow 4d(a+3d)=0\Rightarrow a=-3d\). Hence \(\dfrac{a}{d}=-3\), which is option A. Common mistake: a sign error when expanding the GP condition leads to \(-2\).
